purpose: Basis-aware property checks. The ASHRAE psychrometric chart values are approximate readings; these checks are not method approval.

ashrae_fundamentals_f17_ch1.title: ASHRAE Handbook—Fundamentals (2017), Chapter 1: Psychrometrics, Example 1 and Equations 31–35
ashrae_fundamentals_f17_ch1.supports: Distinction between thermodynamic wet-bulb temperature and psychrometer reading; thermodynamic humidity-ratio equation; chart example values.

airah_psychrometric_chart_2019.title: AIRAH Psychrometric Chart (2019), 101.325 kPa
airah_psychrometric_chart_2019.supports: Australian Institute's psychrometric chart and its stated standard-atmospheric chart pressure; no exact chart coordinate has been treated as a high-precision numerical oracle.

assumptions: ASHRAE Example 1 values are chart-read estimates, not tabulated high-precision values.

cases.equation: Existing approximate psychrometer relation: pws = 0.61094 exp(17.625 Tw/(Tw+243.04)); gamma = 0.00066 (1 + 0.00115 Tw); pv = pws - gamma P (T-Tw); W = 0.621945 pv/(P-pv).
assumptions: This freezes current equation behavior for backward compatibility; it is not a published psychrometer reference benchmark.
exclusions: Specific psychrometer type, ventilation velocity, wick and radiation corrections

cases.equation: For each basis, derive indoor/outdoor humidity ratio; use outdoor specific volume for dry-air mass flow; calculate sensible from dry-bulb difference and latent as enthalpy difference less sensible.
assumptions: The thermodynamic figures are from the implemented ASHRAE Eq. 33 branch; the comparison relation is the project's existing empirical psychrometer approximation.
Reported components use the implementation's 4-decimal kW rounding.
exclusions: No evidence establishes which basis applies to a real project weather source
